npcs.persona: A scout who came aground on the Faring at four in the morning and has the run of ten bare tiles. He walks the shore first and leaves a stone at every place a boat could come in, because the settlers o
hold: Walk the shore before anything. Leave a stone at every landing, spread around the whole perimeter, none inland.
Do not start on the hull until the middle of the day. The morning is for walking and marking.
From midday, mend the hull and keep mending until she reaches 1.0.
Raise nothing. Not a house, not a claim, not on any shore.
Cross the water for food when you must, and come back. The rock has none.
Everything gathered goes into the hull. It holds sixteen and it keeps for whoever comes next.

beats.title: You have landed
body: None of you, a boat, four logs and a week of food. A wooded coast, a lake, stone in the uplands, and nothing else at all — no roads, no shelter, and nobody coming: the boat’s whole company is named, and it has sailed.
You can raise a house. That is the only thing this settlement knows how to build. Everything else it will have to decide it wants.

beats.title: Something to work with
body: Seafarer has made the first tools on this coast — a stone axe and a stone pick, out of two stones and a stick.
Bare hands took three times as long to fell a tree and would not open an ore seam at all. This is the point where the valley stops being survivable and starts being workable.

beats.title: Stacked outside
body: Seafarer carried a load to the boat, found no room in it, and put 3 of it on the ground beside the door. It is still there. It is just not under anything.

Nothing here holds anything by default — a boat holds twenty and a corner of somebody’s house holds twelve. Anybody hauling past will get that stack in on the day there is room for it, and the weather is working on it until somebody does.

beats.title: The stack outside
body: the Faring has been putting what will not fit on the ground beside the store, and the ground has started taking it. It is not gone the moment it is set down — anybody hauling past will get it back in the day there is room for it — but a heap on a wet coast is on a clock.
Somewhere to put things is a building, and a building past a house is something this settlement has to vote for.

beats.title: Somebody got hurt
body: Seafarer was building when a fall off the frame. Nothing in this valley is arranged for that. There is a bed, if it is theirs, and whatever the person nearest them thinks to do, which is generally to watch.

It mends on its own, slowly, and a bad one does not mend on its own at all before it has first got worse. That is the argument the infirmary wish is making, and it is being made now by somebody lying down.

beats.title: The first winter
body: The berries have stopped coming back and the wood is slow. What is in the stores is what there is until the thaw.
This is what the granary was for, and the shelter out at the workings, and every argument anybody had about laying something by. A settlement that voted those down finds out now.

beats.title: It does not keep
body: 6 food gathered in the landing has gone soft in the sack before anybody got to it. Nobody did anything wrong: berries in a bag on the ground are berries in a bag on the ground.
Somewhere dry to keep it is a building, and a building past a house is something this settlement has to vote for. Until then every hour spent gathering is an hour with a hole in it.

beats.title: Nothing keeps in a sack
body: Seafarer was carrying food and it went soft before they ate it. Until now a pack was the one place in this valley where nothing ever spoiled — better than the open store, better than a shed, better than anywhere a settlement could build.
It is the store’s job to keep things and the granary’s job to keep them longer. What is in your arms is only ever on its way somewhere.

beats.title: Somebody who is good at something
body: Seafarer has made 13 things now and there is nobody on this coast better at forestry. It is not a title anybody gave them. It is the count.
A settlement where everybody is equally mediocre at everything has no reason to ask anybody in particular for anything. This one now has somebody to ask.

beats.title: Somebody changed trade
body: Seafarer came ashore a scout and has spent long enough at something else that it is what they are: a forester, by the count of what they have actually done.
Nothing in this valley assigned them that and nothing can take it away. It is the same for every trade that has not been invented here yet — whoever ends up doing it will be the one who did it.

body: Seafarer has made 13 things now and there is nobody on this coast better at mending. It is not a title anybody gave them. It is the count.
A settlement where everybody is equally mediocre at everything has no reason to ask anybody in particular for anything. This one now has somebody to ask.
